description:
Create or update one task.

Single-day by design: one date and optional clock times on it. No
recurrence and no multi-day spans — a farm list is a list of days.

due.description: YYYY-MM-DD. The day it is for.

ends_at.description: Optional HH:MM on the due date.

region_id.description: The saved region this task belongs to.

reminder_only.description: True publishes a reminder; false publishes an entry that takes the slot.

starts_at.description: Optional HH:MM on the due date.

task_id.description: Omit to create; pass an existing id to update.

name: goodearth_task_save
title: Goodearth Task Save
